name: hybrid-freudenthal-kl-character
title: Implement hybrid Freudenthal-KL affine character
description: Use pyw's order-bounded affine Weyl enumeration as a lazy KL orbit index, compute Qtilde only for orbit weights needed at Freudenthal-degenerate targets, and recover the remaining character multiplicities by Freudenthal recursion.
scope: pyw/core affine character computation, bounded Weyl orbit preparation, Freudenthal recursion, affine Verma partition multiplicities, and tests
creator: lelouch

subtasks.name: Extract order-bounded KL orbit preparation without Qtilde evaluation
Implement exact affine root coordinates and lazy KL support queries
Implement bounded affine roots and Verma partition multiplicities
Implement bounded weight tree and Freudenthal recursion
Assemble hybrid character and finite-type decomposition
Verify D4 level -2 vacuum through q^4 and benchmark cold/warm runs
Update mathematical definitions and implementation/test specs

notes: The hybrid path targets complete affine-character coefficients through a requested q order, not the complete explicit KL numerator. Phases 1-6 are complete: bounded orbit preparation, exact root-cone queries, bounded affine roots, Verma/Kostant partitions, a finite-dominant-integral affine highest-weight domain, Freudenthal recursion, lazy Qtilde extraction, and persistent bounded-orbit snapshots. The production path is not specialized to D4, level -2, a vacuum highest weight, or seven fixed targets. D4 order 4 remains a benchmark fixture only. With isolated persistent Q and orbit caches, cold D4 order 4 completed in 50.47 seconds and a new-process warm character completed in 5.49 seconds, with 2112 cached orbit representatives and 162/162 Q cache hits.
